name: gizza-ai/meme-caption
summary: Add a classic top/bottom impact-style caption to an image.

tool.description: Add a classic top and/or bottom meme caption to an image and return a PNG. The text is rendered impact-style: bold letters with an outline, centered horizontally, auto-sized to the image width (long captions wrap), placed near the top and bottom edges, and uppercased by default. Set top and/or bottom (at least one is required); set uppercase=false to keep the text exactly as written, and text_color/outline_color as #rrggbb to recolour the fill and stroke (default white text with a black outline). Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior image tool call).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

top.description: Top caption text (optional). Rendered in uppercase, centered.

bottom.description: Bottom caption text (optional). Rendered in uppercase, centered.

uppercase.description: Uppercase the caption text for the classic meme look (default true). Set false to keep the text exactly as written.
